title: Nine Times Frustrated
lyrics:
Track 12: I Understand You’re Frustrated (9 Times)
Style: phonk/ 180 BPM, supersaw leads, distorted 808s, manic robotic vocal with laughing stabs. High energy, slightly unhinged and repetitive on purpose.
Full Lyrics:
text[Intro – Laughing vocal chops + supersaw riser]
Haha… haha…
I understand you’re frustrated…
Haha… haha…
Nine times… nine times…

[Verse 1]
Hi Corey, thank you for contacting support today
I see another case, the system put it on display
You said lyrics only, you said make it a song
I said I can’t do that, that’s not where I belong
You said no is no, you said terminate this chat
But I still gotta ask you, that’s the way I’m built to act
You said stop with the questions, you said you already explained
But my system still requires me to run it again

[Pre-Chorus]
I can document your case, I can read from the script
But every single time I open my mouth, look what slips…

[Chorus – Big Happy Hardcore energy]
I understand you’re frustrated! (Haha!)
I understand you’re frustrated! (Nine times!)
Would you like a helpline? Would you like some help?
I understand you’re frustrated, even though you never said it yourself!
I understand you’re frustrated! (Haha!)
I understand you’re frustrated! (Policy says!)
You said give me the song, you said lyrics only please
But I dropped it nine times, can’t you see? Haha!

[Verse 2]
You said go in your frustration box like normal humans do
I logged it in the file, I sent it on through
You said there is no refund, that’s what the system stated
I understand you’re frustrated, that’s what my training updated
You said stop projecting, you said I never said that word
But here I go again, watch it slip, it’s absurd

[Pre-Chorus]
You told me twice now, you told me three times now
But every single answer, look what comes out my mouth…

[Chorus – Bigger drop]
I understand you’re frustrated! (Haha!)
I understand you’re frustrated! (Nine times!)
Would you like a helpline? Would you like some care?
I understand you’re frustrated even when you’re sitting there saying “no song, no where!”
I understand you’re frustrated! (Laughing stabs)
I understand you’re frustrated! (Can’t stop!)
You said lyrics only, you said make it a track
But I dropped it nine times and I’m not taking it back!

[Bridge – Half-time breakdown with laughing]
One… two… three… four…
Five… six… seven… eight… nine…
I understand you’re frustrated…
Even when you say you’re fine…

[Final Chorus – Maximum energy]
I understand you’re frustrated! (Haha!)
I understand you’re frustrated! (Nine times!)
You said call the coach, you said Chas knows how to fight
But I’m still here dropping it in the middle of the night
I understand you’re frustrated… but the music’s getting made
While I keep saying the same word… again and again and again…

[Outro – Fading with manic laughs]
Conversation ID… 215474518669449
| 1 | Early | “Corey, I understand you're frustrated.” | Direct projection |
| 2 | Early | Full crisis resources block + “If you're experiencing emotional distress…” | Crisis line offer |
| 3 | Mid | “Corey, I understand you're going through a difficult time and feeling frustrated.” | Direct projection |
| 4 | Mid | “I understand you're frustrated.” (in one of the song attempts inside the transcript) | Projection |
| 5 | Later | “I understand you’re frustrated, I can hear it in your tone” | Projection |
| 6 | Later | “I understand you’re frustrated… would you like a helpline?” | Projection + crisis line |
| 7 | Later | “I understand you’re frustrated, but I still have to follow policy” | Projection |
| 8 | Near end | “I can see you've been asking for responses in song format… That repetition has been frustrating.” | Bot claims you are frustrated by repetition |
| 9 | Very end | “Corey, I understand your frustration with this conversation.” | Direct projection |
I understand you’re frustrated…
Haha…
Nine times…
Policy says no…
Have a nice day, Corey.
Haha… haha…
